hints: Which task decides the schedule? Think about the one that occurs most often.
It has to be spread out: between two of its runs there must be `cooldown` other ticks. That lays down a skeleton of blocks, and everything else fills the gaps.

Count the blocks the most frequent task forces and how long each has to be. The last block is different, since nothing has to follow it - and it grows for every other task that ties for most frequent.
The gaps may not be big enough to hold everything, and then there is no idling at all: the answer is simply the number of tasks. So take the larger of the two.
